Steps:
1. Check CI status: gh pr checks 822
2. IF CI is green:
   a. Check mergeable: gh pr view 822 --json mergeable
   b. If CONFLICTING → follow the merge conflict protocol
   c. If MERGEABLE → merge: gh pr merge 822 --squash --delete-branch
      Verify: gh pr view 822 --json mergedAt --jq '.mergedAt'
      - mergedAt NOT null → merge succeeded
      - mergedAt null → retry merge once; if still null → BLOCKED
   d. Clean up: git worktree remove ../worktrees/issue-785-vram-limiter-test-flaky
3. IF CI is failing:
   a. Get failing run: gh run list --branch fix/issue-785-vram-limiter-test-flaky --limit 1
   b. Get logs: gh run view <RUN_ID> --log
   c. Diagnose and fix in the worktree
   d. Commit and push: git add -A && git commit -m "fix: resolve CI failure" && git push
   e. Wait for CI (poll every 30s, max 10 iterations)
   f. If still failing after 10 → report BLOCKER
4. IF merge conflict:
   a. git fetch origin develop
   b. git rebase origin/develop
   c. Auto-resolve where possible; escalate if unresolvable
   d. git push --force-with-lease origin fix/issue-785-vram-limiter-test-flaky

Report back: final status (MERGED / BLOCKED / CONFLICT), iterations used.
